body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0024 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "User account deleted (4726) - Detects deletion of a user account which can be used to hide traces or sabotage access."
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0024"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1531"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4726"
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $name = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $user, $name over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $deleted_users = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e
}
